    const kasroonVoiceAudio = new Audio();
    kasroonVoiceAudio.preload = 'metadata';
    let kasroonVoiceRequest = 0;
    let kasroonGreeted = false;
    let kasroonPraiseIndex = 0;
    function stopKasroonVoice() {
      kasroonVoiceRequest++;
      kasroonVoiceAudio.pause();
      kasroonVoiceAudio.currentTime = 0;
      const status = document.getElementById('kasroonVoiceStatus');
      if (status) status.textContent = '';
    }
    async function playKasroonVoice(id) {
      stopIntroSequence();
      if (!soundEnabled) { showToast('فعّل الصوت من أدوات الرحلة أولًا'); return; }
      const clip = kasroonVoiceClips[id];
      if (!clip) return;
      stopAllLearningAudio();
      const request = ++kasroonVoiceRequest;
      lastLearningAudio = {type:'kasroon', id};
      const caption = document.getElementById('kasroonVoiceCaption');
      if (caption) { caption.hidden = false; caption.textContent = clip.text; }
      const status = document.getElementById('kasroonVoiceStatus');
      if (status) status.textContent = 'كسرون يتحدث…';
      kasroonVoiceAudio.src = clip.source;
      kasroonVoiceAudio.onended = () => { if(request === kasroonVoiceRequest && status) status.textContent = 'انتهى التسجيل'; };
      try { await kasroonVoiceAudio.play(); }
      catch (error) { if(request === kasroonVoiceRequest && error.name !== 'AbortError') { if(status)status.textContent='اضغط «اسمع صوتي» للمحاولة مجددًا'; } }
    }
    function updateKasroonSpeakingAnimation() {
      const characterTalking = !kasroonVoiceAudio.paused && !kasroonVoiceAudio.ended;
      const introductionTalking = introSequenceActive && introSequenceStep === 2 && !introSequenceAudio.paused && !introSequenceAudio.ended;
      document.body.classList.toggle('kasroon-speaking',characterTalking || introductionTalking);
    }
    function bindKasroonSpeakingAnimation() {
      for(const audio of [kasroonVoiceAudio,introSequenceAudio]) {
        for(const event of ['playing','pause','ended','error','emptied']) audio.addEventListener(event,updateKasroonSpeakingAnimation);
      }
    }
